retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast gothic composition featuring a spindly silhouette atop a curling spiral hill against a massive, pale yellow moon.
triggerTerms: tall spindly character on a cliff

recipe.visualDefinition: A dark, textured landscape dominated by a large, curling purple-black hill that spirals inward, set against a giant circular moon. A thin, elongated figure stands at the peak, while glowing pumpkins dot the foreground graveyard.
coreVisualRelationships: Silhouette figure centered atop the highest point of the spiral
Massive circular moon acting as a backlight for the central subject
Curvilinear hill shape contrasting with the sharp, spindly character lines
Warm orange pumpkin accents against a cool purple and black palette
coreInvariants: The hill must terminate in a tight, inward-curling spiral
The character must be an elongated, thin silhouette
The moon must be a large, flat circular disc behind the subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The main character is small and centered at the top of the hill, framed by the moon.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, pale yellow moon serves as the primary visual anchor and light source.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the curve of the spiral hill upward to the character, then down to the text block on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black space surrounds the moon and hill, creating a sense of isolation.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep purple and black for the landscape and sky.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pale yellow for the moon providing backlighting.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the moon and the silhouette; low saturation in the landscape except for the orange accents.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Tall, irregular serif with varying heights and sharp, thorn-like terminals.
letterConstructionRules: Curled swashes on capital letters like 'C' and 'N'
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'N' features a long, descending tail
The 'C' has an exaggerated, curling top stroke
The 'T' has a crossbar that tapers into a point

composition.relationshipToImage: Integrated into the dark area of the hill

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Pair the decorative display type with a clean, small-caps sans-serif for secondary metadata.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the specific whimsical-gothic aesthetic of the source.
A common fan-made font mimicking this specific style.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a dark, textured landscape with a large purple hill that curls into a spiral on the left. Place a giant pale yellow circular moon in the center background. Add a thin, spindly silhouette standing on the peak. Scatter small glowing orange pumpkins in the dark foreground.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply custom hand-lettered gothic text in white to the lower right area. The text should be tall, irregular, and stacked, with sharp serifs and curling swashes.

verificationChecks: Is the character a thin silhouette against the moon?
Is the text white and gothic with irregular heights?
Are there glowing orange accents in the foreground?

mustAchieve: High contrast between moon and silhouette
Textured, painterly feel on the hill

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the spiral hill does not look like a generic cliff.
Verify the moon is a perfect circle.
Check that the text is legible despite its irregular style.
Confirm the color palette remains dominated by purple, black, and pale yellow.
recipe.reuseFormula: Gothic Spiral + Silhouette + Giant Moon + Irregular Tall Serif
